scope: One local measurement audit; no semantic rescue, training, downloads, paid calls or novel-mechanism claim. Prior failed protocols remain closed.
question: Does sequence shape, rather than later question content, cause apparent pre-question state changes in the existing MLX 4-bit runtime?
sources: Exposed active_a prompts from component_reuse_pilot_2026-10-18. Qwen repeats exact original token IDs; Llama applies its native chat template to the identical system/user text. No held-out linguistic generalization is tested.
lengths: For each model/family, let P end at the sentence-final period. Use sorted unique total lengths [P,P+1,60,63,64,65,67,68,96,128], omitting lengths <P.
suffix_rule: Each suffix must encode to one distinct token. After the identical sentence prefix, repeat that token to the declared total length. These are numerical controls, not grammatical tasks.
repeats: Repeat the first suffix at P,63,67 after the full sweep where lengths exist. No stochastic sampling.
capture: All 28 blocks, incoming residual, attention write, MLP write, outgoing residual; last subtokens of person A, person B, verb, period, and immediate predecessors of verb/period. Save float32 vectors. All captured tokens are in the byte/token-identical causal prefix.
projection_isolation: For each shape, independently evaluate embedding, first-block input RMSNorm, native first-block Q projection, the same Q projection row by row at selected sites, and float32 matmul using the same dequantized 4-bit Q weights. No original full-precision weights or whole-model precision change is implied.
real_prompt_control: For Qwen only, capture the existing eight active_a question/code prompts per family at native lengths and right-padded to exactly 128 tokens with the first suffix token. Append padding only after all original tokens. Native-length and equal-shape results are separate; no language answer is scored on padding.
metrics: Full-coordinate absolute L2, relative L2, maximum absolute coordinate discrepancy, cosine (null if zero) against the shortest prefix run; also same-shape different-suffix differences, repeated-run differences, adjacent-length differences, and real-query differences versus Agent/normal. Record every layer/component/site without peak selection. Absolute scales and cosine are both retained.

predictions.shape_dependent_numerics: At least some different-length runs disagree on identical prefix vectors while same-length different suffix content and repeats agree. Equal-shape real-prompt controls remove or reduce discrepancies. Native Q projection may already be shape dependent; exact offending kernel is not assumed.
predictions.suffix_content_dependence: Different future suffix content produces a prefix discrepancy at equal length as well; this would require investigation of masking, hooks or implementation rather than a semantic conclusion.
predictions.run_to_run_noise: Identical repeated inputs differ, so deterministic shape scheduling alone is insufficient.
predictions.no_reproduction: No difference reproduces; original failure remains unexplained. Do not relax thresholds or change controls.

decision: Report evidence for each rival separately. A bounded shape explanation requires max across-length discrepancy >0.001 in both exposed Qwen families, same-shape/same-prefix content and repeat discrepancies <=0.000001, and padded real-question discrepancy <=0.000001. Llama is an architecture/runtime check, not pooled confirmation. No inference that all prior linguistic effects were artifacts.
stop: Stop after these two models, complete descriptive analysis, literature comparison and a concrete research decision. No new semantic or adaptive patch experiment in this audit.
